key_insight: For quantum approaches to the traveling salesman problem, QUBO requires a quadratic number of qubits, while HOBO reduces qubit requirements at the cost of higher-order interactions.
engineering_relevance: Choosing between QUBO and HOBO involves balancing available qubits against the difficulty of implementing higher-order cost terms.
method: Map the traveling salesman problem to QUBO and HOBO formulations.
Investigate variational quantum approaches, including VQE and QAOA.
Compare the formulations and provide a practical solution recipe.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a detailed comparative study but provides no numerical benchmarks, instance sizes, or measured performance gains.
watch_item: Reduced qubit requirements do not by themselves establish easier hardware implementation or quantum advantage.
paper_title: Solving the Traveling Salesman Problem Using Quantum Devices: QUBO and HOBO Formulations
